./doc/LibreDWG.texi:519:@section CLASSES Section
./doc/LibreDWG.texi:521:The @strong{Classes} Section contains the basic info for all dynamically loaded types for entities and objects.
./doc/LibreDWG.texi:522:It's types start with 500, and are variable. An entity which has no class loaded is displayed as proxy.
./doc/LibreDWG.texi:524:LibreDWG contains support for many classes, but not all. See @file{src/classes.inc} and @file{src/classes.c}.
./doc/LibreDWG.texi:525:We define a stability for each class, one of stable, unstable, debugging and unhandled.
./doc/LibreDWG.texi:527:Objects in @strong{stable} classes are treated as the fixed-type objects with full support. Changes are treated as API breaking.
./doc/LibreDWG.texi:529:Objects in @strong{unstable} classes are sometimes written to DXF or JSON, but not to DWG. Changes are not treated as API breaking. Usually such objects are converted to UNKNOWN_OBJ or UNKNOWN_ENT objects, and when written to DWG converted to PLACEHOLDER, DUMMY or POINT objects with EED pointing to the original class and content.
./doc/LibreDWG.texi:530:Only when rewriting from-to the very same version with the full known unknown_bits blob (e.g. dwgrewrite or json) such classes can persist as such.
./doc/LibreDWG.texi:532:Objects in @strong{debugging} classes are only handled with the develper @code{configure --enable-debug} flag, otherwise ignored. See unstable above.
./doc/LibreDWG.texi:534:Objects in @strong{undhandled} classes are always ignored. There are no fields known, only it's type.
